Operations Lead
Remote
Apply
Description

Globex seeks an operations lead to coordinate its service teams, keep project handoffs clear, and maintain practical working procedures. The lead partners with managers across the organization to resolve recurring delivery problems and improve the reliability of daily operations.

  • Coordinate the weekly delivery review with the service teams.
  • Maintain the operating procedures used for project handoffs.
Requirements

Candidates bring experience coordinating service delivery and writing clear operating procedures. The role requires sound judgment when several teams need help, and careful follow-through on agreed actions.

  • Experience coordinating projects across several teams.
  • Clear written communication and practical problem solving.
Salary Description
Compensation is discussed during the interview process.
